title.full: How your CareShield Life payout is set

summary.text: The starting payout is about $600 a month. Your care needs and arrangements affect your costs, not the payout amount.

details.heading: Starting payout
details.body: The starting CareShield Life payout is about $600 each month. It helps with basic long-term care costs and reduces what you pay yourself.

details.heading: What affects care costs
details.body: Long-term care costs vary based on your care needs and arrangements. This includes staying at home, going to a care centre, or entering residential care. Savings, family support, government help and other support may also help pay these costs.

details.heading: Extra insurance
details.body: You can choose to buy supplements if you want more insurance coverage on top of CareShield Life.

sources.page_title: How are my monthly CareShield Life payouts determined?

quotes.text: The starting payout from CareShield Life of about $600/month will enable Singaporeans to afford their basic long-term care costs by easing their out-of-pocket expenses as the payouts complement their personal savings (including MediSave) and family support.
Long-term care costs vary depending on one’s care needs and arrangements, whether the individual stays at home, goes to a care centre, or enters residential care.
Those who wish to have additional insurance coverage can also opt to purchase supplements on top of CareShield Life.
